name: ReorderList
description: A drag-to-reorder list built on motion's Reorder primitives, with springy layout reflow, a lifted drag state, grip handles and full keyboard reordering via Alt+Arrow keys.
a11yNotes: Renders a semantic <ul>/<li>; each item is focusable with an aria-label including its position. Arrow Up/Down moves focus, Alt+Arrow Up/Down moves the item (focus follows it) and an aria-live region announces the new position; usage instructions are linked via aria-describedby. MotionConfig reducedMotion="user" plus a disabled drag scale respect prefers-reduced-motion.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.description: Unique string items to reorder; changing the content resets the internal order.

propsApi.name: onReorder
propsApi.description: Called with the new order after a drag or keyboard move.

propsApi.name: showHandles
propsApi.description: Show the grip handle icon on each item.

propsApi.name: dragScale
propsApi.description: Scale applied to the item while dragging (ignored under reduced motion).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
